# Cartesia Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that generates spoken audio from text with Cartesia's Sonic models (40+ languages) and browses the Cartesia voice library — narration, voiceovers, spoken-audio files produced from a script. Honest note: TTS synthesis is credit-metered, so long scripts are batched into as few calls as possible; voice cloning is confirmation-gated and not shipped in the CLI. No secrets in the repo — API key stays in Muse's secure vault.
